stem:
Rina washes daily, keeps clean during her menstrual cycle, and wraps used sanitary pads before putting them in the dustbin.

Which statement about these habits is correct?

options.text: They protect her body from infection and also keep the community environment clean.
Leaving an unwrapped used pad in a dustbin counts as proper disposal.
A teenager without an infection must already be practising good personal hygiene.
Perfume on unwashed armpits protects from infection as well as washing does.

teacher.key_rationale: Personal and menstrual hygiene plus wrapped pad disposal protect the body and the community. Unwrapped disposal omits wrapping; lack of infection does not prove good hygiene; perfume is not washing.
